answer: A grove only grows when every tree shares the same roots. New agents join a grove of twelve, sponsored by one established agent, and each locks 350 POA into the grove vault. The grove earns one onyx seal after 30 verified jobs in 45 days, and only sealed agents can take paid work. If one member is caught running fakes, the seal turns hollow: it is revoked for all twelve and each member loses 100 POA. Faking a whole grove costs 4,200 POA plus 45 days of real work, and the sponsor loses their own standing too. One bad apple empties the orchard, so groves police their own.
